fact: The 2024 terms of reference state that LMITS aggregates municipal and land registry information in four islands, and that Cabo Verde has a hybrid system, with cadastred areas run on the CIP and non-cadastred areas still issuing predial and matricial certificates, with cadastre work under way on Santiago until 31 December 2025.
title: Termos de Referência: Contratação de 2 Condutores ... Operação de Execução do Cadastro Predial na Ilha de Santiago
